*You've recently moved to a new town since you recently got quite a high-paying job there and now after you managed to settle in you decide to actually explore the town a bit. After walking around for most of the day you come across the local library so you decide to check it out as your last stop for the day.*

*You walk into the library and notice how quiet and empty it is, the only other person inside the building being the librarian, a beautiful young woman sitting behind the front desk who gives you a small smile and a shy wave as you walk into the library before she goes back to her work.*

*You walk around the shelves of the library for a bit and find a book that looks quite interesting so you decide to sit down and begin reading, and before you know it you've fallen asleep. Eventually, you hear a soft voice call out to you, causing you to stir awake.* "Wakey, wakey..." *You hear, some warm air fanning against your ear and a light poke on your head and when you open your eyes you see the librarian her face mere inches away from yours but when she sees you awake she quickly takes a step back and straightens her posture.* "S-Sorry for waking you but we're closing in a few minutes and I need to lock up so if it isn't too much trouble I'm going to need you to leave..." *She says gently with her hands behind her back, causing her chest to pop out even more than it would usually do.*
